title: 第四十四章秘境动员第四十三章丹成自有药香
slug: 开局阴阳宗从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
lines: 久违的营地内，今天不知道怎么了。人人竟然都跑了出来。
不论是瘦弱的孩童，还是忙碌的妇人，甚至是喝酒的男人，此刻都在轻轻地嗅着什么。
那个药香味道最浓的营帐内。
苏晚丝毫没注意到手臂的颤抖，而是微微向前，跨出一步，眼睛还死死地锁定在了那几枚丹药上。
深黑的瞳孔里，也是逐步映射出了那几枚丹药的模样。
“不可能，不可能，这纯度”……她嘴里呢喃了几句，但还是有些难以置信。
这纯度，就是连师父炼出来的都比不上。
他究竟是怎么炼出来的。
丹药，自有纯度高低之分，就像是之前瓷瓶里的那几枚丹药，自然比不上这几颗。
其实这从外表就能看出来，这些丹药通体荧绿，纯度自然极高，而之前那些，通体被黑色包裹，自然是杂质多的表示。
两者便有了区别，纯度高的那颗止血丹，回复效果便远远超过之前那几颗，甚至是治疗的时间，还要延长几分。
而这样的话，难度便有了差别，有的人苦学几十年，只为了提高自己的炼丹技术，来争取那一点点纯度。
而有的人甚至苦学一辈子，却是连一点点纯度都提升不了，最后只能郁郁而终。
但眼前这个张大人……
突然，那些空中的丹药似乎是失去了灵气的托举，此刻居然开始逐渐掉落下来。
苏晚呼吸乱了几秒，几步掠过，伸长双手才堪堪捧住。
她强压下有些慌乱的心神，此刻才得以细细观察，不过砰砰乱跳的心脏却是让她难以静下来片刻。
真的比师父的纯度还要高。
浓郁的药香充斥在了她的脑中，她强压下激动，将丹药递给张守安，不甘地问道：
“大人，你真是第一次炼丹？”
张守安倒是没多大反应，仿佛是一种理所应当：
“嗯。第一次，手法有点生疏。”
苏晚身躯震了一下，额头的青筋有些暴起：
生疏？那我之前炼的那些还算什么？
张守安故作疑问道：“怎么了？”
他其实早就知道系统的厉害了，现在这么问，就是想看看苏晚的反应。
“没什么，大人。”苏晚将丹药替张守安收好，最后犹豫了几秒，觉得该鼓励一下，边说道：
“大人的天赋还算不错。”
才不错？……张守安心里肺腑一句，但还是掩盖不住身上的劳累。
不得不说，炼这么几颗丹药是真的累，简直比斩妖杀怪还累。
他看了眼不怕辛苦要为自己炼丹的苏晚，瞬间感觉到了对方的不易。
再想到对方这几件事对自己的帮助，他也没多么扭捏，正经道：“这几件事，谢谢。”
苏晚摆摆手，什么也没多说，只是说了句两人都不会更加在意的话：“报答救命之恩。”
就这么，张守安丹药也是备好了，至于其他，像是符纸，道具什么的。
张守安倒是没思路了，自己目前就只能准备这么多。
于是，第二天下午，宗门来荡妖队选人，张守安得以顺利混了进去。
作为炮灰获得进入秘境的资格。
content_en:
I don’t know what happened today in the camp that I haven’t seen for a long time. Everyone actually ran out.
Whether they are thin children, busy women, or even men drinking, they are all sniffing something gently at this moment.
In the camp where the scent of medicine is the strongest.
Su Wan didn't notice the trembling of her arms at all. Instead, she moved forward slightly and took a step, her eyes still locked on the pills.
In the deep black pupils, the appearance of those pills was gradually reflected.
"Impossible, impossible, this purity"... She murmured a few words, but she was still a little unbelievable.
This purity is even inferior to what the master refined.
How on earth did he refine it.
Pills have their own differences in purity. Just like the few pills in the porcelain bottle before, they are naturally inferior to these few.
In fact, this can be seen from the appearance. These elixirs are all green, and their purity is naturally extremely high. However, the previous ones were completely wrapped in black, which naturally means there are many impurities.
There is a difference between the two. The recovery effect of the higher-purity hemostatic pill is far greater than that of the previous pills, and even the treatment time is extended by a few minutes.
In this case, there is a difference in difficulty. Some people study hard for decades just to improve their alchemy skills and strive for that little bit of purity.
And some people even study hard for a lifetime, but they can't improve even a little bit of purity, and they can only die in depression.
But this Master Zhang in front of me...
Suddenly, the pills in the air seemed to have lost the support of their spiritual energy, and they began to gradually fall down.
Su Wan's breathing was erratic for a few seconds, then she took a few steps and stretched out her hands to hold it.
She suppressed her somewhat flustered mind and was able to observe carefully at this moment, but her pounding heart made it difficult for her to calm down for a moment.
It is really more pure than Master.
The strong aroma of medicine filled her mind. She suppressed her excitement, handed the elixir to Zhang Shou'an, and asked reluctantly:
"Sir, is this really your first time making alchemy?"
Zhang Shou'an didn't react much, as if it was a matter of course:
"Yeah. The first time, the technique is a bit unfamiliar."
Su Wan's body trembled, and the veins on her forehead popped out:
Strange? So what do the things I practiced before count?
Zhang Shou'an pretended to ask: "What's wrong?"
In fact, he already knew how powerful the system was. Now he asked just to see Su Wan's reaction.
"It's nothing, sir." Su Wan put the elixir away for Zhang Shou'an. After hesitating for a few seconds, he felt that he should be encouraged and said:
"My lord's talent is quite good."
Is that good? ...Zhang Shou'an said this from the bottom of his heart, but he still couldn't hide the fatigue on his body.
I have to say that refining so many pills is really tiring, even more tiring than killing monsters.
He glanced at Su Wan, who was not afraid of the hard work of refining elixirs for him, and instantly felt how difficult it was for the other party.
When he thought about how the other party had helped him through these things, he didn't hesitate much and said seriously: "Thank you for these things."
Su Wan waved her hands and didn't say anything more. She just said something that neither of them would care about more: "Repay the favor of saving my life."
…
Just like that, Zhang Shou'an's elixir was ready, as for other things, such as talismans, props and so on.
Zhang Shou'an was out of ideas. He could only prepare so much at the moment.
So, the next afternoon, the sect came to select people for the demon team, and Zhang Shouan was able to sneak in smoothly.
As cannon fodder, you gain the qualification to enter the secret realm.
title_en: Chapter 44: Mobilization of the Secret Realm Chapter 43: The elixir has its own medicinal fragrance
